title: cymopterus grayanus var. filicinus
intro: Cymopterus grayanus var. filicinus, commonly known as Gray's licorice-root, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae) known for its medicinal properties. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Gray's licorice-root are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve coughs, and soothe respiratory irritations. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include sesquiterpenes and other terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
